name: Barbell Bench Press (Flat)
description: Lie on a flat bench, grip barbell slightly wider than shoulder width, lower to chest and press up.

instructions: Lie flat on bench with feet on floor
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width
Unrack and lower bar to mid-chest
Press bar up to full arm extension
tips: Keep shoulder blades retracted and depressed
Maintain slight arch in lower back
Drive feet into floor for stability

name: Barbell Bench Press (Incline)
description: Perform bench press on a 30-45 degree incline bench to emphasize upper chest.

instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width
Lower bar to upper chest
Press up to full extension
tips: Slightly narrower grip than flat bench

name: Barbell Bench Press (Decline)
description: Perform bench press on a decline bench to emphasize lower chest.

instructions: Secure legs under pads on decline bench
Grip bar at shoulder width
Lower bar to lower chest
Press up to full extension
tips: Reduced range of motion compared to flat

name: Back Squat
description: Place barbell on upper traps, squat down until thighs are parallel or below, then stand up.

instructions: Position bar on upper traps
Unrack and step back with feet shoulder width
Break at hips and knees simultaneously
Descend until thighs are at least parallel
Drive up through heels to standing
tips: Keep chest up and core braced

name: Front Squat
description: Hold barbell in front rack position across front deltoids, squat to depth.

instructions: Position bar on front deltoids with clean or cross grip
Keep elbows high throughout
Descend to full depth
Drive up maintaining upright torso
tips: Requires good wrist and shoulder mobility

name: Deadlift (Conventional)
description: Lift barbell from floor to hip height with straight arms, hip-hinge pattern.

instructions: Stand with feet hip width, shins close to bar
Hinge at hips, grip bar just outside knees
Brace core, flatten back
Drive through floor, extending hips and knees together
Lock out at top with hips fully extended
tips: Keep bar close to body throughout
Think about pushing the floor away
Engage lats to keep bar path straight

name: Deadlift (Sumo)
description: Wide-stance deadlift with hands inside knees, emphasizes hips and quads more.

instructions: Take wide stance with toes pointed out
Grip bar inside knees
Drop hips, keep chest up
Drive through floor extending hips
tips: Shorter range of motion than conventional

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: Hip hinge with slight knee bend, lower bar to mid-shin keeping it close to legs.

instructions: Hold bar at hip height with overhand grip
Push hips back while maintaining slight knee bend
Lower bar along thighs to mid-shin
Drive hips forward to return to start

name: Overhead Press
description: Press barbell from shoulder height to overhead lockout while standing.

instructions: Hold bar at shoulder height with grip just outside shoulders
Brace core and squeeze glutes
Press bar overhead in slight arc around face
Lock out arms fully overhead
tips: Lean torso slightly back then forward as bar passes head

name: Barbell Row (Bent-Over)
description: Hinge forward and row barbell to lower chest/upper abdomen.

instructions: Hinge at hips to about 45 degrees
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width
Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen
Lower with control
tips: Squeeze shoulder blades together at top

name: Barbell Curl
description: Curl barbell from arms extended to full flexion, isolating biceps.

instructions: Stand with bar at arms length, palms forward
Curl bar up by flexing elbows
Squeeze at top
Lower with control

name: Barbell Lunge
description: Step forward into a lunge with barbell on back, alternating legs.

instructions: Position bar on upper back as in squat
Step forward into lunge position
Lower until back knee nearly touches floor
Push through front heel to return
common_mistakes: Knee passing too far over toes

name: Dumbbell Bench Press (Flat)
description: Press dumbbells from chest level to full arm extension while lying flat.

instructions: Lie on flat bench holding dumbbells at chest height
Press dumbbells up and slightly inward
Lower with control to chest level
tips: Greater range of motion than barbell

name: Dumbbell Bench Press (Incline)
description: Incline dumbbell press on 30-45 degree bench for upper chest emphasis.

instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees
Press dumbbells from chest to full extension
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Row (Single-Arm)
description: Row dumbbell to hip with one arm while supporting on bench with the other.

instructions: Place one knee and hand on bench
Hold dumbbell in free hand, arm extended
Row dumbbell to hip
Lower with control
tips: Keep back flat and parallel to floor

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Press dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead while seated or standing.

instructions: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward
Press overhead to full extension
Lower with control to starting position
tips: Can be done seated for more stability

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: Curl dumbbells from full extension to flexion, alternating or simultaneously.

instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides, palms forward
Curl both dumbbells up simultaneously
Squeeze at top, lower with control
tips: Can alternate arms for heavier weight
Supinate wrists during curl for peak contraction

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
description: Curl dumbbells with neutral (hammer) grip to target brachialis and forearms.

instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides with neutral grip (palms facing each other)
Curl up keeping neutral grip throughout
Lower with control
tips: Targets brachialis and brachioradialis more than standard curl

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: Raise dumbbells out to sides to shoulder height for side deltoid isolation.

instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at sides
Raise arms out to sides until parallel with floor
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: Open arms wide then bring dumbbells together in an arc motion while lying flat.

instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells pressed above chest
Lower dumbbells in wide arc with slight elbow bend
Bring dumbbells back together squeezing chest
tips: Feel stretch in chest at bottom

name: Dumbbell Lunge
description: Step forward or backward into lunge while holding dumbbells at sides.

instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides
Step forward into lunge
Lower until back knee nearly touches floor
Push through front heel to return
tips: Can do walking, reverse, or stationary

name: Goblet Squat
description: Hold dumbbell or kettlebell at chest and squat to depth.

instructions: Hold dumbbell vertically at chest with both hands
Squat down keeping chest up
Elbows track inside knees
Drive up to standing

name: Leg Press
description: Push weighted platform away using legs while seated at 45 degrees.

instructions: Sit in leg press with back flat against pad
Place feet shoulder width on platform
Release safety and lower platform by bending knees
Press platform away to near full extension
tips: Do not lock out knees completely
Adjust foot position for emphasis (high=glutes, low=quads)
Keep lower back pressed into pad

name: Hack Squat Machine
description: Squat on angled sled machine with shoulders under pads.

instructions: Position shoulders under pads, back against rest
Place feet shoulder width on platform
Release safety and lower by bending knees
Push up to starting position
common_mistakes: Placing feet too high or low

name: Smith Machine Squat
description: Squat using barbell fixed in guided vertical track.

instructions: Position bar on upper traps under smith machine
Feet slightly forward of bar
Unrack and squat to depth
Press up to start
tips: Fixed bar path removes balance requirement
Can place feet forward for more glute emphasis
common_mistakes: Feet too far back (like free squat)
Not using full range of motion

name: Chest Press Machine
description: Push handles forward from chest level while seated in machine.

instructions: Adjust seat height so handles are at chest level
Grip handles and press forward
Extend arms fully
Return with control
tips: Machine stabilizes the weight for you
Good for beginners or burnout sets
Adjust seat for optimal chest engagement
common_mistakes: Not using full range of motion

name: Pec Deck (Fly Machine)
description: Bring pads or handles together in front of chest in a fly motion.

instructions: Sit with back flat against pad
Place forearms against pads or grip handles
Bring arms together in front of chest
Return with control

name: Shoulder Press Machine
description: Press handles overhead while seated in shoulder press machine.

instructions: Adjust seat so handles start at shoulder height
Grip handles and press overhead
Extend arms fully
Lower with control
tips: Safer than free weight overhead press

name: Lat Pulldown
description: Pull bar down to chest from overhead cable attachment.

instructions: Grip bar wider than shoulder width
Sit with thighs secured under pads
Pull bar down to upper chest
Return with control

name: Seated Row Machine
description: Pull handles toward torso while seated with chest against pad.

instructions: Sit with chest against pad
Grip handles with arms extended
Pull handles toward lower chest
Squeeze shoulder blades, return with control

name: Leg Extension
description: Extend lower legs against pad from seated position for quad isolation.

instructions: Sit with back against pad, adjust so pivot aligns with knee
Hook ankles under pad
Extend legs until straight
Lower with control
tips: Pause at top for peak contraction

name: Leg Curl (Seated)
description: Curl lower legs under pad from seated position for hamstring isolation.

instructions: Sit with back against pad, adjust so pivot aligns with knee
Position pad above ankles
Curl legs down and back
Return with control

name: Leg Curl (Lying)
description: Curl lower legs against pad while lying face down on machine.

instructions: Lie face down with ankles under pad
Curl legs up toward glutes
Squeeze at top
Lower with control
tips: Point toes down for more hamstring activation

name: Calf Raise Machine
description: Rise onto toes against resistance in standing or seated calf raise machine.

instructions: Position shoulders under pads (standing) or knees under pads (seated)
Place balls of feet on platform
Rise up onto toes as high as possible
Lower heels below platform for full stretch
tips: Pause at top for peak contraction

name: Push-up (Standard)
description: Lower body to floor and press up with arms, body in plank position.

instructions: Start in plank position, hands shoulder width apart
Lower chest to floor bending elbows
Push up to full arm extension
Keep body straight throughout

name: Push-up (Diamond)
description: Push-up with hands close together forming diamond shape, emphasizes triceps.

instructions: Place hands together under chest forming diamond with index fingers and thumbs
Perform push-up keeping elbows close to body
Lower until chest touches hands

name: Push-up (Wide)
description: Push-up with hands placed wider than shoulders to emphasize chest.

instructions: Place hands wider than shoulder width
Lower chest to floor
Press up to full extension

name: Push-up (Decline)
description: Push-up with feet elevated on bench for increased difficulty and upper chest emphasis.

instructions: Place feet on bench or elevated surface
Hands on floor, shoulder width apart
Lower chest toward floor
Press up to full extension
tips: Emphasizes upper chest and front delts

name: Pull-up (Overhand)
description: Hang from bar with overhand grip and pull chin above bar.

instructions: Grip bar with overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders
From dead hang, pull body up until chin clears bar
Lower with control to dead hang
common_mistakes: Not going to full dead hang

name: Chin-up (Underhand)
description: Hang from bar with underhand grip and pull chin above bar, emphasizes biceps.

instructions: Grip bar with underhand (supinated) grip, shoulder width
Pull body up until chin clears bar
Lower with control
tips: Easier than overhand pull-up for most people

name: Dips (Parallel Bars)
description: Lower body between parallel bars by bending arms, then press up.

instructions: Grip parallel bars, arms straight, body suspended
Lower body by bending elbows to about 90 degrees
Press up to full arm extension
tips: Lean forward for more chest, upright for more triceps

name: Dips (Bench)
description: Tricep dip using bench or chair behind body with feet on floor or elevated.

instructions: Place hands on bench edge behind you, fingers forward
Extend legs forward (bent for easier, straight for harder)
Lower body by bending elbows to about 90 degrees
Press up to start

name: Muscle-up
description: Pull up then transition to above the bar and press up in one fluid motion.

instructions: Begin with a slight swing or strict from dead hang
Perform explosive pull-up
Transition wrists over bar at top of pull
Press up into dip position above bar

name: Pistol Squat
description: Single-leg squat with non-working leg extended forward.

instructions: Stand on one leg, extend other leg forward
Squat down on standing leg to full depth
Keep non-working leg extended throughout
Stand back up

name: Plank
description: Hold body in straight line on forearms and toes, isometric core exercise.

instructions: Place forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders
Extend legs, balance on toes
Hold body in straight line from head to heels
Maintain position for target duration
tips: Do not let hips sag or pike

name: Side Plank
description: Hold body in straight line on one forearm and side of foot, lateral core stability.

instructions: Lie on side, place forearm on floor under shoulder
Stack feet and lift hips off floor
Hold body in straight line from head to feet
Maintain for target duration, then switch sides
tips: Free hand on hip or extended overhead

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: Hang from bar and raise legs to horizontal or above for core activation.

instructions: Hang from pull-up bar with arms extended
Raise legs together until parallel with floor or higher
Lower with control to starting position
tips: For added difficulty, raise to bar
Bent knee version is easier progression

name: Cable Crossover
description: Step between dual cable stacks and bring handles together in front of chest.

instructions: Set pulleys to high position
Grip handles and step forward
With slight elbow bend, bring hands together in front of chest
Return with control
tips: Constant tension throughout range of motion
Vary pulley height for different angles

name: Cable Row (Seated)
description: Pull cable handle toward torso while seated with feet on platform.

instructions: Sit on bench with feet on platform, knees slightly bent
Grip handle with arms extended
Pull handle to lower chest/upper abdomen
Squeeze shoulder blades, return with control
tips: Keep back straight, slight lean allowed
Various attachments change grip and emphasis

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Push cable attachment down from chest height to full arm extension for tricep isolation.

instructions: Set cable to high position, grip bar or rope attachment
Stand with elbows at sides, forearms at about 90 degrees
Push attachment down until arms are fully extended
Return with control
tips: Keep elbows pinned to sides throughout
Rope allows more wrist rotation at bottom

name: Face Pull
description: Pull rope attachment to face level, rotating externally at the top.

instructions: Set cable to upper chest or face height
Grip rope with overhand grip
Pull toward face, separating rope ends
Externally rotate arms at end position, return with control
tips: Excellent for rear delts and rotator cuff health
Light weight, high reps works best

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: Raise cable handle out to side to shoulder height for side deltoid isolation.

instructions: Set cable to lowest position, stand sideways to machine
Grip handle with far hand, arm across body
Raise arm out to side until parallel with floor
Lower with control
tips: Can also be done with both arms using dual cables

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: Hinge at hips to swing kettlebell between legs then drive hips forward to chest height.

instructions: Stand with feet wider than shoulders, kettlebell on floor ahead
Hinge and grip kettlebell, hike it back between legs
Drive hips forward explosively to swing KB to chest height
Let KB swing back between legs, repeat
tips: Power comes from hips, not arms

name: Turkish Get-up
description: Rise from floor to standing position while holding kettlebell overhead with one arm.

instructions: Lie on back, press KB up with one arm
Roll to elbow, then to hand
Bridge hips up, sweep leg through to kneeling
Stand up from kneeling, reverse to return
tips: Each step is deliberate, not rushed
Start light to learn the pattern

name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
description: Hold kettlebell by horns at chest and squat to depth.

instructions: Hold kettlebell by horns at chest level
Squat down keeping chest up
Elbows track inside knees
Drive up to standing
tips: Keep elbows inside knees for mobility

name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
description: Clean kettlebell to rack position then press overhead in one flowing movement.

instructions: Swing KB back between legs
Clean to rack position at shoulder
Press overhead to full lockout
Lower to rack, then back to swing
tips: Keep KB close to body during clean
Smooth transition from clean to press

name: Kettlebell Snatch
description: Swing kettlebell from between legs to full overhead lockout in one motion.

instructions: Hinge and swing KB back between legs
Drive hips forward and pull KB overhead in one motion
Punch hand through at top to avoid KB flipping onto forearm
Lock out overhead, lower by guiding KB back down
tips: Master the swing and clean before snatching
Tame the arc to keep KB close
common_mistakes: KB arcing too far from body
Using arm pull instead of hip drive
